name: VRM_PERF_OBLIG_LINES_GT
description: This is a temporary table which is used internally by Oracle.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation line unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_ID
columns.description: Performance obligation unique identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Customer contract header unique identifier.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_LINE_NUMBER
columns.description: Performance obligation line number. This is a running sequence number within a customer contract.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_NUMBER
columns.description: Performance obligation number. This is a running sequence number.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_NUMBER
columns.description: Customer contract number. This is a running sequence number.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line unique identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ADDITIONAL_SLINE_ID
columns.description: Source document additional subline unique identifier.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_EFFECT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the source product accounting is complete.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_METHOD
columns.description: Specifies whether the obligation is satisfied at a point in time or over time. Values are derived from  the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATISFACTION_METHOD.

columns.name: OBLIG_SATISFACTION_STATUS
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_MEASUREMENT_MODEL
columns.description: Specifies how satisfaction will be measured and recorded for a performance obligation line. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATIS_MEAS_MODEL.

columns.name: LINE_SATISFACTION_STATUS
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: LINE_SATISFACTION_DATE
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: NET_QUANTITY
columns.description: Net quantity of the performance obligation line.

columns.name: NET_UNIT_SALES_PRICE
columns.description: Unit selling price after adjusting the return amount.

columns.name: NET_LINE_AMT
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_QUANTITY
columns.description: Original quantity of the performance obligation line.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_LINE_AMT
columns.description: Original line amount  of the performance obligation line.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: ENTERED_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMT
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_NET_CONSIDER_AMT
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: ENTERED_CURRENCY
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a revenue scheduling rule.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_TYPE
columns.description: Type of revenue scheduling rule.

columns.name: REVENUE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date from which the revenue must be recognized.

columns.name: REVENUE_RULE_DURATION
columns.description: Number of periods in which the revenue of this  performance obligation line is to be recognized.

columns.name: REVENUE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date until which revenue must be recognized.

columns.name: DELIVERY_STATUS
columns.description: Delivery status of a source document line. Values are from the lookup VRM_MEA_LINE_DELIVERY_STATUS.

columns.name: DELIVERY_DATE
columns.description: Fulfillment date of a source document line.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_CONFIRM_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether this obligation line will need satisfaction confirmation.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_REV_RULE_ID
columns.description: Revenue scheduling rule unique identifier. Used for satisfaction events creation.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_REV_START_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recognition start date that was most recently used for accounting events creation.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_REV_RULE_DUR
columns.description: Revenue recognition rule duration that was most recently used for accounting events creation.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_REV_END_DATE
columns.description: Revenue recognition end date that was most recently used for accounting events creation.

columns.name: REV_REC_PROCESD_DOC_LINE_ID
columns.description: Source document line unique identifier. Used for satisfaction events creation.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of a ledger.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description: The identifier of the business unit associated to the obligation line.

columns.name: ZERO_AMOUNT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether allocation amount is zero or not.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_BASE_PROPORTION
columns.description: Base number for the satisfaction schedule proportions. The default value is 100. The base number is updated when the schedule rows are updated and it will be the sum of the numerator of the ratio of all schedules.

columns.name: SE_CREATED_FROM_SUBLINE_FLAG
columns.description: No longer used.

columns.name: MAX_SATISFACTION_EVENT_NUM
columns.description: Highest satisfaction measurement number under the performance obligation line.

columns.name: FIRST_AE_REVERSAL_DATE
columns.description: Starting date from which accounting events must be reversed.

columns.name: SINGLE_POB_CONTRACT_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if contract has a single obligation.

columns.name: DEVOLVE_PO_FLAG
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates whether the performance obligation that this promised detail line belongs to is devolved. A performance obligation is devolved if the Devolve performance obligation option is set to Yes in either the performance obligation identification rule or the implied obligation template that was used during identification of the performance obligations.

columns.name: INITIAL_PERF_EVT_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if initial performance accounting event was created.

columns.name: INITIAL_PERF_EVT_EXPECTED_DATE
columns.description: Date on which initial performance event is expected to be created.

columns.name: POB_SATISFACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Satisfaction status of the performance obligation. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATISFACTION_STATUS.

columns.name: POB_SATISFACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the performance obligation is satisfied.

columns.name: POL_SATISFACTION_STATUS
columns.description: Satisfaction status of the performance obligation line. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_SATISFACTION_STATUS.

columns.name: POL_SATISFACTION_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the performance obligation line is satisfied.

columns.name: POL_FIRST_SE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the first satisfaction event for a performance obligation line is created.

columns.name: POL_SATISFIED_QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity satisfied on the performance obligation line. Used only when the model is 'Measure Quantity Satisfied'.

columns.name: POL_SATISFIED_PERCENT
columns.description: The percentage satisfied on the performance obligation line. Used only when the model is Measure Percentage Satisfied.

columns.name: POL_AE_CREATION_STATUS
columns.description: Performance obligation line accounting event creation status.

columns.name: LINE_STATUS
columns.description: Performance obligation line status

columns.name: CONTRACT_UPDATE_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Revenue contract update template identifier.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Specifies the type of line sent from the source system. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_DOCUMENT_LINE_TYPE. Blank is equivalent to ORA_NEW_LINE.

columns.name: POB_FIRST_SE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the first satisfaction event is created for a promised detail line under a performance obligation.

columns.name: SATISFACTION_DERIVATION_STATUS
columns.description: Specifies whether the satisfaction status and satisfaction date on the performance obligation and promised detail line should be derived again.

columns.name: UNPROCESSED_RET_LINE_QUANTITY
columns.description: Quantity of the return lines related to promised detail which are not processed for accounting.

columns.name: PERF_OBLIGATION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Obligation type of a performance obligation. Values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_PERF_OBLIGATION_TYPE_CODE.

columns.name: BILLING_LINE_CREATED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether zero amount billing line is created for the implied promise detail line upon full satisfaction.

columns.name: LATEST_PERIOD_ACTION_CODE
columns.description: Latest satisfaction period action that was processed on this document line. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_PERIOD_SUBLINE_ACTION.

columns.name: TOTAL_REVERSAL_DAYS
columns.description: Total number of days the service was suspended. This value is calculated based on the number of days between the effective dates of all reversals and their corresponding reinstatements.

columns.name: LATEST_REVERSAL_DAYS
columns.description: Number of days since the latest suspension of service. This value is calculated based on the the number of days between the effective plan end date of the promised detail and the recently processed reversal subline.

columns.name: REVISED_RULE_END_DATE
columns.description: Revised revenue recoginition end date for the satisfaction plan after the service is reinstated.

columns.name: RECUR_LINE_PROCESSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates that the line was processed by the Create Contract Renewal Source Data process. Valid values are from the lookup type VRM_YES/NO.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_EXISTENCE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether the promised detail line has any additional satisfaction events associated with it. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_LINE_ASE_EXISTENCE.

columns.name: ASE_FULFILLMENT_PROCESS_CODE
columns.description: Indicates whether all the additional sublines that indicate the fulfillment of the additional satisfaction events for the promised detail line are processed. Valid values are Yes, No, and Invalid.

columns.name: ADDITIONAL_SE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Overall fulfillment status of all the additional satisfaction events on the promised detail line. Values are derived from the lookup type ORA_VRM_LINE_SATISFACTN_STATUS.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_CONTRACT_DATE
columns.description: Date the parties entered into an agreement.

columns.name: ASE_ELIGIBLE_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that is equivalent to the fulfillment of all of the additional satisfaction events.

columns.name: PSE_ELIGIBLE_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that is equivalent to the fulfillment of all the primary satisfaction events.

columns.name: ASE_PENDING_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that is pending to be recognized as revenue, even though the additional satisfaction event is fulfilled.

columns.name: PSE_PENDING_REVENUE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that is pending to be recognized as revenue, even though the primary satisfaction event is fulfilled.

columns.name: SE_REVENUE_RECOGNIZED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of revenue recognized upon fulfillment of both the primary and additional satisfaction events.

columns.name: LAST_PSE_DATE
columns.description: Last fulfillment date of the primary satisfaction event.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_ASE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the additional satisfaction event according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value indicates the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.

columns.name: ELIGIBLE_PSE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the primary satisfaction event according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value indicates the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.

columns.name: RECOGNIZED_SE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of both the primary and additional satisfaction events according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value indicates the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.

columns.name: CONTRACT_CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Revenue contract currency code.

columns.name: EXCHANGE_RATE
columns.description: Conversion rate of promised line.

columns.name: CONTR_CUR_ALLOCATED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Allocated transaction price in contract currency

columns.name: ASE_ELIGIBLE_DATE
columns.description: Eligible fulfillment date of the additional satisfaction event.

columns.name: ALLOCATION_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: The allocation currency basis used to allocate and recognize revenue for a contract. Valid values are from the lookup type ORA_VRM_ALLOCATION_METHOD.

columns.name: PENDING_ASE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the additional satisfaction event that is pending revenue recognition according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value is either the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.

columns.name: PENDING_PSE_VALUE
columns.description: Value of the fulfillment of the primary satisfaction event that is pending revenue recognition according to the satisfaction measurement model. The value is either the satisfied quantity, satisfied percent, or period equivalent amount.
